fields.title: Roadmap: a commitment to direction, not a list of dates
fields.keyTakeaway: A useful roadmap answers what problems we are solving in the coming months and why those specific ones. A list of features with dates is a plan that lies to everyone right away and in the very first quarter.
fields.checkQuestion: Sales is asking for exact dates for three features six months out. What will you give them instead?
fields.blocks/0/text: Key question of the node: **which value to amplify first?**
fields.blocks/1/subtitle: Precision drops with distance — and that's honest
fields.blocks/1/items/0: **Now** — what's in progress. Concrete, with an expected outcome.
fields.blocks/1/items/1: **Next** — problems we will tackle next. The solution isn't chosen yet.
fields.blocks/1/items/2: **Later** — directions and bets. No commitments and no dates.
fields.blocks/1/items/3: **Each item has a problem and a metric,** not a feature name. This allows changing the solution without changing the promise.
fields.blocks/2/text:
Bad: "March — recommendations. April — dark theme. May — social features. June — audiobooks."
By May, half isn't done, the other half isn't done right, and everyone feels deceived.

Working:
Now — "people drop a book on chapter two"; goal — increase the share of people finishing their first book from 31% to 40%; testing reminders and short reading targets.
Next — "the first week shows no value": onboarding and first book selection.
Later — a bet on social reading, no solution yet.

This gives sales what they need: what to talk to customers about and what not to promise.
fields.blocks/2/title: Vetka, two roadmaps for the same half-year
fields.blocks/3/text: If it exists to report on execution, it turns into a list of promises, and the team starts picking safe tasks instead of necessary ones.
fields.blocks/3/title: A roadmap is a document for discussion, not for reporting
fields.blocks/4/text: **The link to experiments is direct.** The "now" horizon contains a problem, and hypotheses for it are prioritized using the same ICE/RICE. Experiment results move the roadmap, not the other way around.
fields.blocks/5/text: There is work with a hard date: law, contract, season. On the roadmap, it stands as a hard commitment with a date — and such items must be few, otherwise the document becomes a feature plan again.
